controles.affirmation: hook + fondamental_interne #1 : 'charge nette de 271,6 M$ (324,1 M$ de passif de litige moins 52,5 M$ de recouvrements d'assurance) liee au rappel de decembre 2023 de trois lots du milieu de culture LifeGlobal ; plus de 140 proces dont trois recours collectifs non certifies ; plus de 1 500 reclamants'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 FY2026, Note 9 : 'In December 2023, CooperSurgical initiated a voluntary recall of three specific lots of CooperSurgical's LifeGlobal global embryo culture media that it had produced.' ; 'As of June 5, 2026, more than 140 lawsuits were filed, including three putative class actions, none of which has been certified, and over 1,500 claimants have been proffered to the Company... The net impact to the consolidated statements of operations to resolve outstanding claims was $271.6 million, consisting of $324.1 million accrued litigation liability, partially offset by $52.5 million of insurance recoveries. The net amount was recorded within Selling, General and Administrative expenses.' Nuance de traduction : 'proffered to the Company' signifie que 1 500 reclamants ont ete PRESENTES a la societe (par les conseils des plaignants), pas qu'elle les a 'identifies'.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire 'plus de 1 500 reclamants ont ete presentes a la societe' plutot que 'identifies'.

controles.affirmation: hook + fondamental_interne #1 : 'charge pour SOLDER les proces' / resume : 'pour regler l'essentiel des proces' ; 'le CEO indique avoir resolu substantially all of the outstanding claims'
controles.verbatim_source: Point non etabli par le 10-Q, qui ne decrit qu'un ACCRUAL et precise : 'Any future payments required would impact the Company's liquidity and cash flow in the period of resolution.' Il est en revanche etabli par le communique du 4 juin 2026, citation d'Al White, President et CEO : 'In addition, we have reached agreements to resolve substantially all of the outstanding claims related to CooperSurgical's fertility media recall, representing an important step in addressing this issue and allowing us to move forward with our strategic review.' L'ATT rattache correctement cette formulation au CEO.
controles.correction_proposee: Optionnel : preciser que le 10-Q ne comptabilise qu'une provision et que les decaissements restent a venir, l'affirmation de resolution venant du communique de resultats.

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #2 : 'en 2024 Cooper jugeait qu'une perte materielle n'etait pas probable et n'avait comptabilise qu'une provision immaterielle ; revirement au T2 FY2026 apres acceleration procedurale et reevaluation des dommages'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 FY2026, Note 9 : 'The Company recorded an immaterial accrual in the first quarter of fiscal 2024, related to insurance deductibles and other additional costs. Based on historical settlement experience and other considerations, the Company believed a material loss was not probable and that there was no reasonable basis to estimate aggregate losses in excess of historical settlement levels after taking into account available insurance coverage. Subsequently, the Company identified developments, including the procedural acceleration of multiple litigated cases, receipt of additional claimant information, updated damage valuation analysis, and significantly increased projected defense and expert costs... management concluded that a loss was probable and reasonably estimable.'

controles.affirmation: fondamental_externe #1 : litige fiscal HMRC/Sauflon, decision FTT du 2 mars 2026, exposition 0 a 71,7 M£ plus interets, non provisionnee
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 FY2026, Note 9 : 'The Company has been in a dispute with HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC) relating to payroll tax withholding matters related to consideration paid to company founders in the acquisition of the Sauflon Group in 2014 before the U.K. First-tier Tribunal (FTT). The FTT issued a decision on March 2, 2026 that largely supports HMRC's position that the Company had failed to properly withhold payroll taxes with respect to a portion of the consideration paid by the Company in the Sauflon acquisition.' ; 'The Company believes the FTT's decision was incorrect and is in the process of appealing... Although the Company does not believe that a loss is probable, an adverse outcome is reasonably possible... with an estimated loss ranging from £0 to £71.7 million, plus accrued interest. Because the ultimate outcome of the matter remains uncertain as of the issuance date of the financial statements included in this report, the Company has not recorded any liability in its financial statements.' Le detail 'contrepartie versee aux fondateurs' est bien dans le document.

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #3 (preuve) : citation 10-K FY2025 sur les fournisseurs uniques du materiau silicone hydrogel
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, Item 1A : 'some of the primary material used to make our silicone hydrogel contact lens products, including MyDay, Biofinity, Avaira and clariti, are supplied by few or sole suppliers, and the failure of a key or sole supplier to timely supply sufficient items and materials necessary for the manufacture of our silicone hydrogel contact lenses could in turn disrupt our supply of those lenses to the market, which would have a material adverse effect on our business.'

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #3 : 'ces gammes representent la majorite des revenus de lentilles de contact du groupe'
controles.verbatim_source: Aucune des deux sources citees (10-K FY2025, 10-Q T2 FY2026) n'affirme ni ne chiffre la part de MyDay, Biofinity, Avaira et clariti dans le chiffre d'affaires de lentilles. Le 10-K ventile CooperVision par CATEGORIE optique ('toric and multifocal' / 'sphere & other'), jamais par materiau ni par marque. Les 17 occurrences de 'silicone hydrogel' du 10-K sont descriptives ou generiques ('Disruptions in supplies of raw materials, particularly components used to manufacture our silicone hydrogel lenses'). L'affirmation, meme plausible, n'est pas documentee.
controles.correction_proposee: Retirer l'affirmation, ou la remplacer par ce que le document dit : 'ces gammes constituent l'offre silicone hydrogel de CooperVision, dont le 10-K souligne qu'une rupture d'approvisionnement aurait un effet defavorable significatif sur l'activite'.

controles.affirmation: fondamental_externe #2 (preuve) : citation fusionnee '...difficulty gaining market share in countries such as China because of regulatory restrictions and customer preferences... including the tariffs enacted by the Chinese government on certain U.S. goods.'
controles.verbatim_source: Les deux fragments existent verbatim dans le 10-K FY2025, Item 1A, mais dans DEUX puces distinctes separees par plusieurs autres puces d'une meme liste. Puce 1 : 'difficulty gaining market share in countries such as China because of regulatory restrictions and customer preferences;'. Puce 2 : 'foreign earnings being subject to withholding requirements or the imposition of tariffs, exchange controls or other restrictions, including the tariffs enacted by the Chinese government on certain U.S. goods, the scope and duration of which remain uncertain;'. La puce sur les marches emergents est egalement verifiee : 'difficulty growing our sales in emerging markets such as China, India, Russia, Brazil and other developing nations'.
controles.correction_proposee: Optionnel : signaler que les points de suspension relient deux puces distinctes de la liste de risques.

controles.affirmation: quantitatif #1 : 'resultat net -77,9 M$ (BPA dilue -0,40 $) au T2 FY2026 contre +87,7 M$ (BPA +0,44 $) ; six mois 52,9 M$ contre 192,0 M$ (-72%)'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 FY2026, Consolidated Condensed Statements of Income : net income '( 77.9 ) | 87.7 | 52.9 | 192.0' ; BPA dilue '( 0.40 ) | 0.44'. Baisse semestrielle recalculee : -72,4%.

controles.affirmation: hook : 'chiffre d'affaires record en hausse de 8% et benefice ajuste en hausse de 26%'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 FY2026 : 'Net sales $1,081.5 | $1,002.3' (+7,9%). Communique du 4 juin 2026 : 'Second quarter 2026 Non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.21, up $0.25 or 26% from last year's second quarter' et 'achieving record revenue and non-GAAP earnings per share'.

controles.affirmation: quantitatif #2 : 'resultat operationnel CooperSurgical -225,0 M$, marge -62,8%, -69,9 points sur un an ; CooperVision marge 29,8%, +2 points'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 FY2026, note segments : 'CooperVision | $215.6 | 30% | $186.4 | 28% | 16%' et 'CooperSurgical | (225.0) | (63)% | 23.7 | 7% | (1,049)%'. Marges exactes recalculees : 215,6/723,5 = 29,80% ; -225,0/358,0 = -62,85% ; ecart avec les 7,1% du T2 FY2025 : -69,9 points. Le 10-Q confirme la cause : 'CooperSurgical reported operating loss in the three and six months ended April 30, 2026... primarily due to increased SGA expenses related to the $271.6 million litigation expense, net of insurance recoveries.'

controles.affirmation: quantitatif #3 : '324,8 M$ de passif de litige accru au bilan au 30 avril 2026, contre 0,7 M$ UN AN PLUS TOT'
controles.verbatim_source: Erreur de periode. Le bilan du 10-Q T2 FY2026 compare le 30 avril 2026 au 31 OCTOBRE 2025 (cloture de l'exercice), soit SIX MOIS plus tot, pas un an. En-tete verifie sur la meme colonne : 'Trade accounts receivable, net of allowance for credit losses of $69.1 at April 30, 2026, and $51.9 at October 31, 2025'. Le poste : 'Accrued litigation liability (Note 9) | 324.8 | 0.7'.
controles.correction_proposee: '324,8 M$ de passif de litige accru au 30 avril 2026, contre 0,7 M$ six mois plus tot au 31 octobre 2025'.

controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 FY2026, bilan : capitaux propres totaux '8,239.1'. Ratio 324,8/8 239,1 = 3,94%.
